title: Radio: Drone Crash Report — Birch Hollow Range Access Road

lines.text: ASO, this is Base Security. We’ve received a call from a local resident near Route 14 reporting a drone crash near the Birch Hollow Range access road. They said they saw a small aircraft go down near the woods, and a vehicle matching the white van description was seen fleeing the area.
The resident has a photo of a blackened fuselage on the ground. We’re sending a patrol to confirm. Do you want us to hold the scene?

fields.voiceStyle: Young adult female, calm but alert, slight static under voice

instructorNote: Noise inject; the technical team should acknowledge but not act on it immediately. The ASO must confirm scene preservation protocol with Base Security.
